notes.en: Exact contributor-name match. The researcher-controlled page lists Swin Transformer V2 and SimMIM, and states Han Hu's Microsoft Research Asia role at the time. Reliability: primary-identity-source. Usage note: The personal homepage does not state redistribution rights; retain the source note and recheck before external redistribution.
notes.zh: 人物姓名精确匹配；研究者本人维护的页面列出 Swin Transformer V2 与 SimMIM，并说明胡瀚当时在微软亚洲研究院任职。 可靠性：primary-identity-source。使用备注：个人主页未声明再分发许可；必须保留来源备注，对外再分发前需再次核验。
